SqlConnectionEncryptionMode.summary: Specifies the encryption mode that was negotiated between the client and SQL Server for a connection.
SqlConnectionEncryptionMode.remarks: This type describes the negotiated outcome reported by . It is distinct from , which describes the requested setting.

None.summary: No encryption was negotiated for the connection.

LoginOnly.summary: Only the login packet was encrypted; subsequent traffic was not encrypted.

Full.summary: The TDS session was encrypted after the pre-login exchange (TDS 7.x encryption).

Strict.summary: TDS 8.0 strict encryption was used: the TLS handshake occurred before any TDS traffic was exchanged.
